title: 課程詳情頁移除 Review 區塊 (courses/[slug])
content: CourseDetailView 目前包含 Review / 評價區塊（第 289–339 行），顯示學員評論與評分。本卡片將此區塊完全從前端移除，簡化課程頁面，聚焦 syllabus、講師、時段、報名等核心資訊。後端 API 與 Prisma schema 保留不動，僅移除前端渲染。

findings: CourseDetailView.tsx:289–339 has a conditional review section rendering {course.reviews && course.reviews.length > 0 && ...} with Star icon, dict.sections?.reviews header, and review cards (authorName, authorRole, rating, comment)
Star imported from lucide-react on line 16 — used only by this section
dict.sections?.reviews key exists in en.json line 127 ('Student Reviews & Testimonials'), zh-hk.json line 126, zh-cn.json line 126
CourseReview interface in types.ts (lines 33–40) and reviews field in DetailedCourse (line 77) — used by this section
API and Prisma schema have Review model — NOT removed, kept for potential Phase 2
evidence.residual: Backend (API route Prisma include, map-course-detail.ts mapping, Prisma Review model) left untouched — only frontend UI removed. Backend cleanup is out of scope.

acceptance: Remove review section JSX from CourseDetailView.tsx (lines 289–339)
Remove dict.sections?.reviews key from en.json, zh-hk.json, zh-cn.json
No changes to backend (API route, Prisma schema, mapping) — backend Review model stays
No changes to CourseReview type or DetailedCourse.reviews — leave for potential future use
Page layout adjusts naturally after removal — syllabus, instructors, schedules sections remain intact
npm run typecheck passes with 0 errors
npm run lint passes with no new warnings
files: src/components/courses/CourseDetailView.tsx (update — remove review section JSX + Star import)
verification: Visit /en/courses/{slug} → no Reviews section renders. Page layout is clean with no visual gaps. Remaining sections (Syllabus, Instructor, Schedule, CTA, FAQ) all display correctly. tsc --noEmit → 0 errors.
